method: Surprise = how unusual a number is for a player of his impact. Per stat and season: weighted regression of the per-36 rate (counting stats) or percentage on SiPM offence, defence (with squares and product) and minutes per game, fitted on players above the minutes floor. The gap between his number and that expectation is divided by the spread expected for his impact and sample size, so short samples need a bigger gap to stand out. z = +2 means about 1 player in 40 sits that far above what his impact predicts.
